bodies:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production modular sprite atlas for an original 2D dwarf colony game, matching the attached approved dwarf's SIMPLE flat warm-color shapes, thick dark brown outlines and continuous rounded pawn body. Reference image is STYLE reference only.
OUTPUT: transparent background, exactly 5 rows by 3 columns evenly spaced on a 1536x2560 portrait canvas. Each cell 512x512, center x256/768/1280 and center y256/768/1280/1792/2304. Each cell contains ONLY ONE HEADLESS BODY MODULE, no head, beard, hair, arms, hands, legs, feet or shadows. Leave at least 60px empty margin inside each cell. All bodies same height about 350px, same top and bottom anchor. Render an extremely short neck stump at top for a head to overlap, smooth compact sides and ONE unbroken rounded bottom, no divided legs.
Columns: FRONT, RIGHT PROFILE (face direction would be right), BACK. True profile silhouettes, not squeezed front views.
Rows in order:
1 Male: standard sturdy dwarf torso, fairly broad shoulders, plain flat peach upper body, opaque cream underwear band covering bottom quarter.
2 Female: slightly narrower shoulders, subtly tapered waist and rounded lower body, modest plain opaque cream bandeau upper underwear AND opaque cream bottom underwear. No bust anatomy or cleavage.
3 Thin: slimmer straight torso, still squat adult dwarf proportion, plain flat peach upper body and cream bottom underwear.
4 Hulk: very broad angular shoulders and upper torso, tapering lower body, NO muscle lines or pectorals, flat peach and cream bottom underwear.
5 Fat: broad rounded middle, soft continuous oval lower body, flat peach and cream bottom underwear.
ALL: avoid anatomical detail, nipples, belly buttons, abs, realistic shading, gradients, texture, ornament, outlines within skin. Underwear is a simple unbroken cream band across the bottom with no crotch split. Body silhouette must match the approved reference concept. These are adult stylized pawn tokens, not realistic cut-off human anatomy. Bold clean dark outline consistent across cells. No text, numbers, labels, grid, ground, scenery. Equal spacing, no overlapping cells. Transparent background.
work:

Row order Male, Female, Thin, Hulk, Fat; columns front, right profile, back. These are HEADLESS armless legless rounded pawn torso modules.
Replace ALL visible skin and underwear with a muted teal work tunic covering each entire body shape, with a plain broad brown belt around its lower third and a small square ochre buckle on FRONT only; side shows belt wrapping naturally, back has continuous belt without buckle. Small simple dark V notch at top center front; side/back simple round collar. NO skin, head, hair, beard, hands, arms, sleeve stubs, legs, feet. Garment is a closed fully opaque body replacement on the same continuous silhouette. Same thick dark brown outline and flat color blocks as reference, at most one flat shadow, no muscle detail, texture, folds, gradients or shine. Preserve distinct shapes especially broad shoulder Hulk, slender Thin, wide belly Fat, tapered Female. No text, grid or extra props. Every asset isolated with generous transparent padding, no overlaps.

heads: Use case: stylized-concept. Modular head sprite atlas for the SAME approved original dwarf game style in the attached image. STYLE reference, not an atlas to copy. Transparent 1536x1536 square sheet, EXACTLY 3 rows x 3 columns of BALD BEARDLESS HEADS ONLY. Each head in equal 512 square cell with generous empty padding. Columns front, true RIGHT PROFILE nose pointing RIGHT, back. Rows: broad round face; broad square face; slightly narrower oval face. Same mature adult dwarf identity family, genders can share all heads. SAME scale head height 320px in every cell. Short thick mature face, ears, wide bulbous nose, thick short dark angular eyebrows, tiny black oval eyes without whites, simple small mouth line. Neutral slightly stern but friendly expression, not angry. Flat warm peach skin with one flat small shadow max. Back view plain bald scalp with ears, no facial features. Every head has a clean rounded bald scalp outline so a separate hair overlay can be attached, no head hair, sideburns, beard or moustache. NO neck, body, accessories, clothes, horns, wrinkles, muscles, teeth, realistic rendering, 3D shading or gradients. Match the reference's bold dark brown thick outline and minimal simple color shapes exactly. Adult sturdy dwarf, never child/baby doll. No text, labels, grid, shadows or scenery.
hair: Use case: stylized-concept. Create isolated HAIR OVERLAY modules for the bald dwarf heads in image1. Image2 is approved art style. Transparent background, exactly 3 rows x 3 columns evenly spaced square 1536x1536 atlas. Columns front, right profile (face would point RIGHT), back. Rows 1: chunky swept brown short hair matching approved reference; row2: softly wavy shoulder-length brown bob with large chunky locks; row3: two thick brown braids with a simple parted scalp cap. ONLY HAIR, no heads, faces, skin, eyes, ears, necks, bodies or beards. Front and profile hair must leave face area genuinely transparent (open arch at bottom), back hair covers back of head as a continuous mass. Match head round scalp contours: front head width about 300px in a 512cell, side profile has nose toRIGHT and backofscalp toLEFT. No hair hanging over the eye area. Flat chunky shapes with bold dark brown outline, 3-5 locks, very few internal lines, muted brown with one simple shadow, no gradients, realistic strands, shine or texture. Equal cells, generous empty padding. No text, grid or shadows.
